rules.cwe_name: Inclusion of Web Functionality from an Untrusted Source
rules.description: Using a resource from an untrusted or compromised domain makes your code vulnerable to receiving malicious code.

rules.cwe_name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
rules.description: If the 'X-Frame-Options' setting is not provided, a malicious user may be able to overlay their own UI on top of the site by using an iframe.

rules.cwe_name: Reliance on Undefined, Unspecified, or Implementation-Defined Behavior
rules.description: If the id of an HTML attribute is malformed, its interpretation may be browser-dependent.

rules.cwe_name: Permissive Cross-domain Security Policy with Untrusted Domains
rules.description: Cross-origin resource sharing (CORS) policy allows overly broad access.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Control of Resource Identifiers ('Resource Injection')
rules.description: creating arbitrary environment variables from user controlled data is not secure

rules.cwe_name: Assignment to Variable without Use
rules.description: Assigning to the special 'exports' variable only overwrites its value and does not export anything. Such an assignment is hence most likely unintentional.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
rules.description: Instantiating a template using a user-controlled object is vulnerable to local file read and potential remote code execution.

rules.cwe_name: Access of Resource Using Incompatible Type ('Type Confusion')
rules.description: Sanitizing an HTTP request parameter may be ineffective if the user controls its type.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Data within XPath Expressions ('XPath Injection')
rules.description: Building an XPath expression from user-controlled sources is vulnerable to insertion of malicious code by the user.

rules.cwe_name: NULL Pointer Dereference
rules.description: Trying to invoke a value that is not a function will result in a runtime exception.

rules.cwe_name: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')
rules.description: Server-side URL redirection based on unvalidated user input may cause redirection to malicious web sites.

rules.cwe_name: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
rules.description: Making a client-to-server request with user-controlled data in the URL allows a request forgery attack against the client.
